Messages.Author: Melissa A. Battaglia
Messages.Body:
A group of us have run into the following "not in the rules situation":

A vampire of say 4 blood armed with a machine gun enters combat with a
vampire of 4 blood who is unarmed. The first vampire sprays his opponent
for 4 damage. His opponent plays "burst of sunlight" - HOW IS THE DAMAGE
RESOLVED?

Two possibilities:

1) Burst of Sunlight does 2 aggravated to both vampires - both in torper -
ignore the machine gun damage - it just doesn't matter

2) the machine gun damage is applied first, reducing the one vampire to 0
blood who is then hit with an aggravated wound and is burned

Anyone got an idea - any satisfactoryt ruling, especially an OFFICIAL one,
would be greatly appreciated by the Jyhad players at Cornell University.

Send mail to ja...@cornell.edu

Thanks - The Kurgan
